name: Wood Chop VR
summary:
Wood Chop VR puts you right in the forest with one goal: chop wood and build your power. Swing your axe, break logs, collect resources, and upgrade your tools to chop faster and harder. As you progress, you’ll unlock new areas, better gear, and unique mechanics that keep the gameplay fresh and addictive.
